title: A Job Behind the Curtain
title_zh: 在社区剧场做幕后工作
context: Iris 想参加社区剧场的演出活动，向志愿者 Theo 询问幕后工作并报名一次排练帮忙。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，练习题为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Iris
dialogue.en: I saw the poster for your community play. Are you looking for help?
dialogue.zh: 我看到了你们社区戏剧的海报。你们需要帮忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: Theo
dialogue.en: Yes, we need people backstage as well as actors.
dialogue.zh: 需要，我们既需要演员，也需要幕后工作人员。

dialogue.speaker: Iris
dialogue.en: I am shy about acting, but I would like to help.
dialogue.zh: 我不太敢演戏，不过想帮忙。

dialogue.speaker: Theo
dialogue.en: We could use someone to organize the props before each scene.
dialogue.zh: 我们需要有人在每场戏之前整理道具。

dialogue.speaker: Iris
dialogue.en: What kind of things are the props?
dialogue.zh: 道具都是什么样的东西？

dialogue.speaker: Theo
dialogue.en: For this play, they include a suitcase, a hat, and a letter.
dialogue.zh: 这部戏的道具包括一个手提箱、一顶帽子和一封信。

dialogue.speaker: Iris
dialogue.en: That sounds manageable. Would someone show me where they go?
dialogue.zh: 听起来我能做。会有人告诉我它们放在哪里吗？

dialogue.speaker: Theo
dialogue.en: Yes. Our stage manager has a list and will show you.
dialogue.zh: 会的。我们的舞台监督有清单，会教你。

dialogue.speaker: Iris
dialogue.en: I am free Tuesday evening. Could I come to a rehearsal?
dialogue.zh: 我周二晚上有空。我可以来一次排练吗？

dialogue.speaker: Theo
dialogue.en: Please do. We start at seven, and I can meet you at the side door.
dialogue.zh: 欢迎。我们七点开始，我可以在侧门接你。

dialogue.speaker: Iris
dialogue.en: Wonderful. I will bring a notebook to write things down.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我会带个笔记本记下来。

dialogue.speaker: Theo
dialogue.en: See you Tuesday. We are glad to have your help.
dialogue.zh: 周二见。很高兴有你帮忙。

expressions.example: She helps backstage during the play.

expressions.zh: 演出道具，是 properties 的简称。
expressions.example: The table and the letter are props.

expressions.zh: 舞台监督，负责协调舞台工作。
expressions.example: The stage manager checked the list.
The actors met for a rehearsal.
I write things down so I remember them.

pronunciation: rehearsal 重音在第二音节 HEAR；props 末尾的 /ps/ 两个辅音都要轻轻带出。

practice.title: Part 1 · Performances
practice.prompt: Do you enjoy watching live performances?
practice.answer: Yes. I like seeing how performers react to the audience, and a small theater can feel very welcoming.

practice.title: Part 2 · Helping at an event
practice.prompt: Describe an event you helped with. Say what the event was, what you did, and what you learned.
practice.answer: I helped backstage at a small community play last year. The stage manager showed me a list of props, including a hat and a suitcase. Before each scene, I checked that the actors could find what they needed. At first I was nervous about forgetting something, so I wrote notes. The show went smoothly, and I learned that quiet work behind the scenes matters too. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Community arts
practice.prompt: Why might a community benefit from a local theater?
practice.answer: It gives people a chance to create something together, including those who prefer working behind the scenes. Performances can also introduce neighbors to stories and ideas they might not otherwise encounter.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读询问幕后工作的句子，再说明你想怎样参与一次演出。
practice.answer: Are you looking for backstage help? I can organize the props. Could someone show me where everything goes?
